goal: Use this quiet turn to establish Vulnerable and cover all incoming.
guidance: Only one follower attacks for 8. Bash on Priest costs 2 and applies three turns of Vulnerable; then Iron Wave on Priest costs 1, deals 9 after Vulnerable and gives 8 block. Plating adds one. This achieves defense plus future Bludgeon setup. Do not substitute plain Defend: it gives the same block while losing leader damage. Armaments is less valuable than preserving energy for Bash plus Iron Wave. Pact's End remains inactive below three exhausted cards.
